Prime Factorization Visualizer

Break any integer into primes with a factor-tree walk: each split of p × rest shown until all primes.

2\u00B3 \u00D7 3\u00B2 \u00D7 5
Prime factorization

  




  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter an integer of 2 or more.
  2. Press Factorize.
  3. Follow each tree split down to the prime factors.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How does it find factors?
Trial division from 2 upward — the first divisor found is always prime, so the tree splits n = p × (n/p).
What do the superscript numbers mean?
Exponents: 2³ × 3² × 5 means 2·2·2 × 3×3 × 5 = 360.
How large a number can it handle?
Up to 10¹². Primes near the cap are instant since trial division only runs to √n.
